"""锁定本轮原始字节并集成 v64 候选；不构建、不运行求解器。"""

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import zipfile


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / "knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm"
STAGE = ROOT / ".tools/v64-kernel"
PLAN_SHA = "43a4851be22770b5c07302b9cfe815b0ac8fb54cec53012d29bc1ff6b66d499e"
BASELINE_SHA = "bec3ba78313f6be093125ed09a8c60e15ca0b1ab1623352cd5b52e287d5bd8a3"
ANCESTOR_IDENTITY_SHA = "287e15ce18f0b5613f5d26f845d1103591c553b7797f27d5b0cd1da19ec4974c"
ANCESTOR_ZIP_SHA = "7e5b5f13b1481feeab8d6e2ef0db51d999a56799635f6abb39509ab47105e4ce"
# 三份 staged 来源由 kernel 交付后逐项锁定。
STAGED_SHA256 = {
    "src/ipm.cpp": "a6b1b7e84ba0e9f482999dae0131dd634a78a54533f5a5d1485e19b3823a6e5d",
    "include/solver/detail/ipm_homogeneous.hpp": "61a8c91170ff91ecdf0761a45c5956ed3443546f31fb7419e8be17337c23cab4",
    "tests/test_ipm.cpp": "7c3f560ed9705e7f3c675fc7bcfaf53b6b6113f66be2bc69588ac0aa8340dda0",
}
BACKUP = DATA / "v64-starting-source.zip"
OUTPUT = DATA / "v64-integration.json"
BACKUP_IDENTITY = DATA / "v64-starting-source.json"


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(content):
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def sha(path):
    return digest(Path(path).read_bytes())


def unique_object(items):
    result = {}
    for key, value in items:
        require(key not in result, "JSON 出现重复字段：" + key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def read_locked(path, expected):
    content = Path(path).read_bytes()
    require(digest(content) == expected, "输入身份不匹配：" + str(path))
    return json.loads(content.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique_object,
        parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("非有限 JSON：" + value)))


def source_path(base, name):
    require(isinstance(name, str), "来源路径必须是字符串")
    relative = PurePosixPath(name)
    require(not relative.is_absolute() and relative.as_posix() == name and
        all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in relative.parts) and
        "\\" not in name and ":" not in name, "来源路径不是规范相对路径：" + name)
    target = (base / name).resolve()
    require(target.is_relative_to(base.resolve()) and target.is_file(), "来源越界或不存在：" + name)
    return target


def file_map(base, expected):
    require(isinstance(expected, dict), "文件身份必须是字典")
    actual = {name: sha(source_path(base, name)) for name in expected}
    require(actual == expected, "当前文件身份变化：" + str(base))
    return actual


def save_new(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as target:
        json.dump(value, target, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        target.write("\n")


def main():
    require(all(isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 64 for value in STAGED_SHA256.values()),
        "三份 staged 来源尚未最终锁定，禁止执行")
    require(not any(path.exists() for path in (BACKUP, BACKUP_IDENTITY, OUTPUT)), "禁止覆盖本轮已有备份或集成记录")
    plan = read_locked(DATA / "v64-plan.json", PLAN_SHA)
    require(plan["baseline_check"] == {"file": "v64-baseline-check.json", "sha256": BASELINE_SHA},
        "计划的起始检查身份变化")
    baseline = read_locked(DATA / "v64-baseline-check.json", BASELINE_SHA)
    starting_path = source_path(DATA, plan["starting_state"]["file"])
    starting = read_locked(starting_path, plan["starting_state"]["sha256"])
    require(baseline["passed"] is True and baseline["files"] == starting["files"] and
        baseline["libraries"] == starting["libraries"] and baseline["solver_sha256"] == starting["solver_sha256"],
        "真实起始检查与计划选择不一致")
    require(len(baseline["files"]) == 95 and len(baseline["libraries"]) == 17, "起始来源或库数量不符")
    ancestor_info = plan["implementation_ancestor"]
    require(ancestor_info["identity_file"] == "ipm-v62-identity.json" and
        ancestor_info["identity_sha256"] == ANCESTOR_IDENTITY_SHA and
        ancestor_info["source_zip_file"] == "ipm-v62-source.zip" and
        ancestor_info["source_zip_sha256"] == ANCESTOR_ZIP_SHA, "实现祖先与锁定身份不符")
    ancestor = read_locked(DATA / "ipm-v62-identity.json", ANCESTOR_IDENTITY_SHA)
    ancestor_archive = DATA / "ipm-v62-source.zip"
    require(sha(ancestor_archive) == ANCESTOR_ZIP_SHA == ancestor["source_zip_sha256"], "v62 来源包身份变化")
    require(set(ancestor["files"]) == set(baseline["files"]), "祖先与当前95来源集合不同")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(ancestor_archive) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        require(len(names) == len(set(names)) == 95 and set(names) == set(ancestor["files"]),
            "v62 来源包成员集合不符")
        ancestor_contents = {name: archive.read(name) for name in names}
    require({name: digest(content) for name, content in ancestor_contents.items()} == ancestor["files"],
        "v62 来源包成员身份不符")

    changed = plan["changed_source_files"]
    require(isinstance(changed, list) and len(changed) == len(set(changed)) == 10, "计划不是十份唯一来源")
    require(set(STAGED_SHA256).issubset(changed), "staged 文件不在计划变更范围")
    require(sorted(changed) == sorted(name for name in baseline["files"]
        if baseline["files"][name] != ancestor["files"][name]), "祖先相对当前的差异不是计划十来源")
    targets = {name: source_path(ROOT, name) for name in changed}
    staged_contents = {name: source_path(STAGE, name).read_bytes() for name in STAGED_SHA256}
    require({name: digest(content) for name, content in staged_contents.items()} == STAGED_SHA256,
        "staged 来源身份变化")
    require(all(staged_contents[name] != ancestor_contents[name] for name in STAGED_SHA256),
        "staged 来源缺少相对祖先的修改")
    replacements = {name: staged_contents[name] if name in staged_contents else ancestor_contents[name]
                    for name in changed}
    require(replacements["src/ipm.cpp"].count(b"ipm-cpu-0.51.0") == 1 and
        b"ipm-cpu-0.50.0" not in replacements["src/ipm.cpp"], "候选版本不符")
    require(replacements["tests/test_cli.py"].count(b"cls.benchmark.platform.platform()") == 1,
        "候选丢失独立平台预热")
    comparison = replacements["tests/test_compare_lp.py"]
    fixture = comparison.split(b"def test_old_ipm_reports_remain_compatible_when_method_is_not_requested", 1)[1]
    fixture = fixture.split(b"\n    def ", 1)[0]
    require(b'"backend_version"] = "ipm-cpu-0.47.0"' in fixture and
        b'("ipm_homogeneous_", "ipm_extended_krylov_")' in fixture,
        "旧报告 fixture 缺少明确旧版本或历史字段清理")

    original = {name: source_path(ROOT, name).read_bytes() for name in baseline["files"]}
    require({name: digest(content) for name, content in original.items()} == baseline["files"],
        "当前95来源已改变，禁止覆盖用户工作")
    file_map(ROOT, baseline["libraries"])
    executable = source_path(ROOT, "build/release/solver.exe")
    require(sha(executable) == baseline["solver_sha256"], "当前程序身份变化")
    parent = read_locked(DATA / "ipm-v57-identity.json", plan["parent_identity_sha256"])
    require(sha(ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v57.exe") == parent["solver_sha256"] and
        sha(ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v62.exe") == ancestor["solver_sha256"], "冻结父版程序身份变化")
    evidence = read_locked(DATA / plan["evidence_file"], plan["evidence_sha256"])
    require(evidence["passed"] is True, "上一轮独立证据尚未通过")
    expected_after = dict(baseline["files"])
    expected_after.update({name: digest(content) for name, content in replacements.items()})
    require(sorted(name for name in expected_after if expected_after[name] != baseline["files"][name]) == sorted(changed),
        "实际候选差异超出或少于计划十来源")

    # 不经文本解码保存原字节，保留混合换行及独立测试修复。
    with zipfile.ZipFile(BACKUP, "x", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as archive:
        for name in sorted(original):
            archive.writestr(name, original[name])
    with zipfile.ZipFile(BACKUP) as archive:
        require(len(archive.namelist()) == 95 and set(archive.namelist()) == set(original), "原字节备份成员不完整")
        require(all(archive.read(name) == content for name, content in original.items()), "原字节备份回读不符")
    backup_sha = sha(BACKUP)
    save_new(BACKUP_IDENTITY, {"created_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA, "baseline_check_sha256": BASELINE_SHA, "files": baseline["files"],
        "libraries": baseline["libraries"], "solver_sha256": baseline["solver_sha256"],
        "source_zip_file": BACKUP.name, "source_zip_sha256": backup_sha,
        "source_count": 95, "readback_verified": True, "lp_runs": 0})

    # 备份期间也不得出现并行修改；全部预检完成后才开始写入生产来源。
    file_map(ROOT, baseline["files"])
    file_map(ROOT, baseline["libraries"])
    require(sha(executable) == baseline["solver_sha256"], "备份期间程序身份变化")
    require(sha(DATA / "v64-plan.json") == PLAN_SHA and sha(DATA / "v64-baseline-check.json") == BASELINE_SHA,
        "备份期间计划或基线记录变化")
    for name, path in targets.items():
        path.write_bytes(replacements[name])
    file_map(ROOT, expected_after)
    file_map(ROOT, baseline["libraries"])
    require(sha(executable) == baseline["solver_sha256"], "集成意外改变程序")
    result = {"passed": True, "created_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA, "baseline_check_sha256": BASELINE_SHA,
        "starting_state_sha256": plan["starting_state"]["sha256"],
        "ancestor_identity_sha256": ANCESTOR_IDENTITY_SHA, "ancestor_source_zip_sha256": ANCESTOR_ZIP_SHA,
        "staged_files": STAGED_SHA256, "changed_source_files": changed,
        "backup_source_zip": BACKUP.name, "backup_source_zip_sha256": backup_sha,
        "backup_identity_file": BACKUP_IDENTITY.name, "backup_identity_sha256": sha(BACKUP_IDENTITY),
        "before_files": baseline["files"], "files": expected_after,
        "libraries_before_and_after": baseline["libraries"], "solver_before_and_after": baseline["solver_sha256"],
        "all_prechecks_completed_before_source_writes": True, "backup_readback_verified": True,
        "platform_test_warmup_preserved": True, "old_report_fixture_historical_version": "ipm-cpu-0.47.0",
        "integrator_sha256": sha(__file__), "integrator_source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        "lp_runs": 0, "build_runs": 0}
    save_new(OUTPUT, result)
    print(json.dumps({"passed": True, "changed_sources": len(changed), "source_count": len(expected_after),
        "backup_sha256": backup_sha, "lp_runs": 0, "build_runs": 0}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
